title: Not every system with a Markov blanket feels

statements.text: Not every ergodic random dynamical system with a Markov blanket experiences feelings. These are the basic mechanisms by which feeling arises, and consciousness is what such existential imperatives feel like in the vertebrate nervous system. The subjective states of protozoa must entail affect in this technical sense, but they need not feel as vertebrates do.

sources.quote: We do not mean to imply by our proposals that every (ergodic) random dynamical system that possesses a Markov blanket will experience feelings.
we do not claim that they feel like we do
